content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 10+2 or its equivalent; two years experience as Clerk in any State Government or Government of India; Hindi or Sanskrit as one of the subject in Matric or Hindi as one of the subject in Higher Education. Experience: Two years experience as Clerk in any State Government or Government of India Other conditions: Must be working as a Clerk or equivalent post on a regular basis in any Department / Board / Corporation / Authority of the Haryana Government Integrity must be beyond doubt Passing the SETC Test is mandatory

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Haryana Fisheries Department Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Employees with pending charge sheet or vigilance inquiry under Rule 7 or Rule 8 Employees with withheld annual increment order in force

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation for a period of 1 year or till the appointment of a Clerk through direct recruitment, whichever is earlier

content_sections.heading: How Will Haryana Fisheries Department Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Verification of service records and ACR grading Issuance of No Objection Certificate by Parent Department Selection based on eligibility, ACR grading (at least 70% Good or Very Good), and clearances

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Haryana Fisheries Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Haryana Fisheries Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 20 vacancies for Clerk.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Haryana Fisheries Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Page 2 and 3 of the PDF) and send it to the address given in the notification, to reach by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Matrix Level Rs. 21700 (FPL-3).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 10+2 or equivalent with 2 years experience as Clerk and Hindi/Sanskrit in Matric or Higher Education.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be working as a Clerk or equivalent post on a regular basis in any Department / Board / Corporation / Authority of the Haryana Government. Integrity must be beyond doubt. Passing the SETC Test is mandatory.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Employees with pending charge sheet or vigilance inquiry under Rule 7 or Rule 8. Employees with withheld annual increment order in force.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Verification of service records and ACR grading. Issuance of No Objection Certificate by Parent Department. Selection based on eligibility, ACR grading (at least 70% Good or Very Good), and clearances.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation for a period of 1 year or till the appointment of a Clerk through direct recruitment, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Haryana.
